item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 20/Mar/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a humid maritime airstream, there will be fog over the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be rather warm during the day. A cold front is expected to move across the coast of Guangdong on Wednesday morning. The weather will become appreciably cooler with showers and thunderstorms over the region. It will be windy and still showery in the following couple of days. An upper-air disturbance will bring unsettled weather to southern China over the weekend.

Weather: Mainly cloudy. Foggy in the morning and at night. Sunny intervals during the day with one or two showers later.
Temp range: 20 - 25 C
R.H. range: 75 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
